meta.name: calendar-to-workflow
meta.description:
Converts calendar events and schedules into Claude Code workflows, meeting prep
documents, and standup notes. Use when the user mentions calendar events, meeting
prep, standup generation, or scheduling workflows. Trigger with phrases like
"prep for my meetings", "generate standup notes", "create workflow from calendar",
or "summarize today's schedule".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把日历日程自动整理成会议准备和站会纪要
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常为开会和站会汇报花费大量时间
copy.tagline_en: Turn calendar events into meeting prep and standup notes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you spend lots of time on meeting prep and daily standups

howto.what: Claude 根据你给的日历数据（.ics 文件、粘贴内容或口头描述），生成会议简报、站会笔记或可重复的工作流脚本，并会结合仓库近期提交和未关闭 PR，加上项目背景。
howto.when: 当用户提到日历事件、会议准备或站会生成等，或说“准备我的会议”“生成站会笔记”时触发。

say.text: 我下午有架构评审和1:1，帮我准备会议简报。
say.note: 会为每个会议生成一份含背景和议题的简报。

say.text: 根据昨天的 git 记录和日历，生成今天的站会笔记。
say.note: 会总结昨日完成、今日计划和阻塞项。

say.text: 创建一个每周一早上的工作流，自动预读本周日历。
say.note: 会生成可重复执行的脚本并输出周预览文档。

howto.what_en: Claude reads your calendar data (ICS files, pasted content, or verbal schedule) and produces meeting briefings, standup notes, or repeatable workflow scripts. It can also pull recent commits and open PRs for project context.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions calendar events, meeting prep, or standup generation, e.g., 'prep for my meetings' or 'generate standup notes'.

say_en.text: I have an arch review and a 1:1 this afternoon. Prep briefings for both.
say_en.note: Generates a briefing per meeting with context and agenda.

say_en.text: Generate today's standup notes from yesterday's git log and calendar.
say_en.note: Summarizes yesterday, today's plans, and blockers.

say_en.text: Create a Monday-morning workflow that pre-reads this week's calendar.
say_en.note: Produces a repeatable script and a weekly overview doc.
